name: labtrack
description: LABTRACK monorepo for web administration, Android instructor app, shared domain logic, and Supabase backend schema.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @labtrack/shared && npm run build -w @labtrack/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @labtrack/shared && npm run typecheck -w @labtrack/web && npm run typecheck -w @labtrack/mobile
